items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: Well, you know, Kid Ernest was in that sometimes too.

ctx.x: Somebody told me once that Shots, did you know Shots Madison or Kid Shots? That was a, he used to sell homebrew. That was his main job, I think, during Prohibition. Yeah. But Fess told us. Yeah.
Well, you know, Kid Ernest was in that sometimes too.
Did you know Shots, he was uptown.
